notes.title: [Dev Diary #30] The Faces of History: Leaders in Gilded Destiny
notes.content: [h2][/h2][p]Salutations industrialists! [/p][p][/p][p]I'm Marc, a Producer on Gilded Destiny. In today's dev diary, we're going to update you on the progress we've been making with Leaders, focusing on art style, animations, modding, and the importance of Leaders in the game. We also have a video version of this Dev Diary, which includes detailed examples of our portraits, animations, and implementation workflow.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="iejjpoDHNJk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you haven’t already, please wishlist Gilded Destiny on Steam, subscribe on [url="https://www.youtube.com/@aquilainteractive"]YouTube[/url]. You can additionally join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf"]Discord[/url], or [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/gildeddestiny/"]Reddit[/url] community to stay up to date.[/p][p][/p][p]For more information about the Leader System itself, be sure to check out our previous [url="https://youtu.be/qA9NUb0SztQ"]Dev Diary on Leaders[/url] from last year, where we discussed the Leader UI, Leader traits, positions, and skills, and general mechanics of the Leader system.[/p][p][/p][p]In Gilded Destiny, Leaders represent the famous men and women of the nineteenth century who feature in our game as recruitable characters, that can fill governmental, military, and researcher roles. The game is also able to autogenerate generic Leaders who can be used to supplement (or even replace) the unique, historical Leaders, in order to cover both historical and alt-historical scenarios.[/p][p][/p][p]Without further ado, let's dive in.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Creating Portraits[/h2][p]Given the number of countries and the overall time-span of the game, Gilded Destiny will have a significant number of historical Leaders. We've therefore had to be somewhat selective about which Leaders get unique portraits, and which get generic portraits that are just representative of their class and nationality. This means that we can still include plenty of Leaders with the appropriate traits and stats, but without being too constrained by the number of unique portraits we can reasonably produce (while still making sure that some famous faces are making an appearance).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/134ad6160ee3ba3b7765421d433e76d56b552fa0.png"][/img][/p][p]Leader portraits use a realist painterly style that allows us to represent a wide range of historical personas with a fitting degree of detail and personality. We collaborate closely with an outsourcing studio, which allows us to scale the production of portraits while still maintaining a high level of artistic quality and historical authenticity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/5e5b45bd691c34cdc139d46b8862da24840b45bd.png"][/img][/p][p]We aim to preserve some degree of personal and cultural variation as well, within a manageable scope. While most 19th century military uniforms of the era tended to imitate the French style, we include some variations, such as red coats for British generals and white coats for Austrians. We also include some special clothing, such as the yellow dragon robes of the Qing Emperors.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/7c8ed6077c1e92b6a563f3261ff83da8e5ca121f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summary:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Historical Leaders will be given unique portraits where possible, although some will have generic portraits so that we can include a much wider range of real people.[/p][/*][*][p]Leader portraits use a painterly style that mimics nineteenth-century portraiture.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaders will have some degree of personal and cultural variation in their uniforms and clothing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Leader Animations[/h2][p]After a portrait is finalized, polished, and approved by our artists and designers, we move to the animation phase. The portrait is separated into core components: head, clothing, body, and background. Each piece is exported as a high-quality PNG for animation using Spine (our rigging tool), in which our artists create meshes and skeletal rigs. Then we animate subtle, natural movements, such as breathing or posture shifting, to evoke a sitting-for-a-portrait feel.[/p][p][/p][p][i]We'd like to think that if animated portraits existed in the nineteenth century, this is how they would have looked.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Currently, animations are randomly selected from a pool of eight animation clips, creating an ongoing loop of non-repetitive motion that the Spine Unity plug-in blends automatically. This setup creates an ongoing loop that gives every portrait a quiet presence without requiring custom animations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/1c4402dd9a9eb733a039731e381c2d602268e4e8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Summary:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Animations are subtle and non-obtrusive—as if the Leader were sitting for a portrait.[/p][/*][*][p]A pool of 8 animations will be randomly selected and blended smoothly via the Spine Unity plug-in.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Choosing Historical Leaders[/h2][p]For unique portraits, we focus on the heavy-hitters of the 19th century—people whose names (and sometimes faces) are instantly recognizable, and whose actions defined an era or changed the course of history. However, we've also included a few historical Leaders who could've made a big difference in alt-history scenarios (e.g., Ernest Augustus).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/4161d7abda346a8521cd424abebdeed0263329ea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In game, historical Leaders will usually be added to a country's Leader pool when they started to make their mark on world history. When or if a Leader appears is sometimes dependent on certain conditions—for example, a Leader of a certain religion will only appear if that religion is allowed to hold office. Leaders might also appear after being unlocked via an event chain.[/p][p][/p][p]Leaders have stats that will indicate the roles for which they are best suited. In addition, they'll have individual traits—both good and bad—and might gain new traits with experience. Of course, Leaders will also have a lifespan that will run out, meaning that they will need to be replaced during the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/51a854c6ead92a017b12a0caf77241920129ee07.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summary:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unique portraits will mostly be reserved for significant historical figures, but with a few alt-history figures[/p][/*][*][p]Whether a historical Leader appears could be determined by specific conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaders have stats and traits that indicate the roles for which they might be best suited.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Inputting Leaders and their portraits into the game[/h2][p]Once a Leader portrait has been completed, it is packaged for Unity and integrated into the current build via the game Editor.[/p][p][/p][p]Within the Editor, we first add Leader info (name, nationality, age, gender, etc.) and then assign the portrait head and clothing—for example, Otto von Bismarck.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/1cf1188da869c7ff4ca705ac71c20e5fffe6049d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Summary:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A completed Leader portrait is packaged for Unity and integrated via the game Editor[/p][/*][*][p]Leader info is first added to create a new Leader in the game itself[/p][/*][*][p]Then the portrait head and clothing are assigned to the Leader info.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Modding portraits and Leaders into the game[/h2][p]Finally, you can upload your own Leader portraits into the game via the game Editor! We are designing the Editor primarily with modders in mind.[/p][p][/p][p]Modding portraits into the game involves uploading a PNG file to the game Editor into game resources. The closer the dimensions are to our Leader's heads, the better it will render in the game. For instance, our office manager's portrait, as seen in the example, does not line up perfectly. We will then link the PNG file to a specific Leader component (a head or clothing) and then choose basic descriptors for age, body type, etc., for the new portrait.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/b06be708804a7c5e10469e0d371c9c464449faa3.png"][/img][/p][p]We can then assign a new head to a new Leader or swap the head of an existing Leader. By this same process, you can edit any existing Leader in the game—you can switch heads, body types, clothing, and even portrait backgrounds.[/p][p][/p][p]Any changes can then be exported from the game editor and copied into the game files—a process which we aim to streamline before release.[/p][p][/p][p]When complete, you can see your changes in the game. Here's one we made earlier: the United Kingdom has a new, very regal Leader, ready to steer his country to greatness, food, and comfy boxes! If you like the idea of an official Gilded Cats of Destiny mod, let us know![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/055f13c7535f35dfb5329ede786a8745b814a26c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summary:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Modders will be able to use the game Editor to easily switch portraits or create new Leaders[/p][/*][*][p]Modders can also edit existing Leaders, changing stats, body type, age, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]The process involves uploading a PNG file to the editor and linking the portrait to a Leader.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Alpha Update[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Completed at the End of August[/b][/p][list][*][p]Research for military unit initialization is completed, implementation still needs to be done[/p][/*][*][p]Forest placement has been pushed back to September[/p][/*][*][p]Continued creating Portraits for Historical Leaders and Generic Portraits—mostly generics in August, with a focus on East Asian and European portraits[/p][/*][*][p]Input Political Parties UI[/p][/*][*][p]Completed implementation of Political Parties[/p][/*][*][p]Partially completed Pop distributions for Asia and Africa—initial Job balance complete, culture and religion setup under refinement[/p][/*][*][p]Completed 2D Army unit icons[/p][/*][*][p]Completed the redesign of the Regiment UI[/p][/*][*][p]Finished the main terrain illustrations[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Targets for the End of September[/b][/p][list][*][p]Create Culture and Religion traits that fulfill a mechanical necessity, e.g., a trait that discourages pops from converting to animism[/p][/*][*][p]Continue balancing and refining the economy[/p][/*][*][p]Begin work on forests[/p][/*][*][p]Refine the size and population densities of certain provinces for the sake of balance[/p][/*][*][p]Continue creating Portraits for Historical Leaders and Generic Portraits, including African and more European and East Asian portraits[/p][/*][*][p]Complete 2D Navy unit icon[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Postamble[/h2][p]We hope you've enjoyed this Dev Diary, and as always, if you have any questions or comments, let us know.  You can find us on  [url="https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf"]Discord[/url],  [url="https://www.youtube.com/@aquilainteractive"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://x.com/GildedDestiny"]X[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/AquilaIA/"]Facebook[/url], and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/gildeddestiny/"]Reddit[/url] for discussions, updates, and feedback.[/p][p]Until our paths converge once more, we bid thee farewell![/p][p]May your destiny be a gilded one.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Alpha Roadmap Update #15
notes.content:
[h3]Salutations Industrialists,[/h3][p]We're excited to share the progress we've made in June and update you on our Alpha Roadmap.

[b]Closed Alpha Release[/b]
We're excited to announce that the Gilded Destiny Closed Alpha has been released! The Closed Alpha is now available to all of our supporters who backed us on Kickstarter!

[b]How to Access the Closed Alpha[/b]
Everyone who backed us on Kickstarter should head over to the previous update we shared about accessing the Closed Alpha for further instructions. You will be able to access a link to agree to the non-disclosure agreement and then claim your key!

[b]Incorporating Your Feedback[/b]
With the release of the Closed Alpha, our development team is actively incorporating feedback from players into the development process. That being said, incorporating feedback requires an active and devoted player base to continuously play, enjoy, and test Gilded Destiny. We are incredibly thankful to our backers who supported our vision early on and for the commitment to making Gilded Destiny as gilded as possible. Already, we have received a large amount of feedback, suggestions, comments, bug reports, and a bit of praise on the Closed Alpha.

[b]Roadmap and Milestones[/b]
With the Alpha now released, our Alpha Roadmap posts have come to an end. It's been great sharing this journey with you, but not to fret, we'll now be providing development updates in our regular Dev Diaries! If you haven't seen them, check out our most recent one: [url="http://aquila.now/46b8ME7"]People, Progessions, and Power[/url].

[b]Join the Community[/b]
You can also reach out to us on Discord for anything else. Join the Gilded Destiny [url="https://discord.com/invite/3d77T9gxDF"]Discord[/url] Server

[b]A Note to Non-Backers[/b]
First and foremost, to the valued members of our community who are not backers, we want to thank you for your continued patience as we develop and refine Gilded Destiny to a level that will be playable and enjoyable at release.

Now with that excitement over, let's have a look at what we've accomplished in June and early July:

[/p][h3]Accomplished in June[/h3][hr][/hr][p][b]Economy & Trade[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Continuing the work on balancing the economy[/p][/*][*][p]A major update to Trade has taken place and is being tested[/p][/*][*][p]As part of the work on the economy, the design for Trade has undergone some revisions and is now behaving in a more stable fashion. The new system has been implemented and is currently being tested. This also comes with a new UI that is currently in the refinement and polish stage. [/p][/*][*][p]Trade UI redesign has been completed.[/p][/*][*][p]A major update to resource distribution and the overall UX for interacting with resource deposits is currently being implemented. This has also required significant changes to the map, which are now largely complete. [/p][/*][/list][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/7426cf2f5f07f09f626a466c1b2cf8e27f62caeb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/881eb1ca36ffa2de2782eadc614561e10cca95c8.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Population & Society[/b]  	[/p][list][*][p]Continued work on Pop distribution. We reviewed and corrected Culture and Religions across Europe. Refined some Professions data. [/p][/*][*][p]New Literacy Rate and education system have been implemented and are currently being tested[/p][/*][*][p]Started work on an official Glossary for terms and translation purposes.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Terrain & Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]Continued editing terrain: West, South, and Central Africa West Africa has been completed. South and Central Africa will be completed by the end of July.[/p][/*][*][p]Continued development of Map Mode Filter feature. Ongoing. It will be completed by the end of July. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/6b7a00215d2af20523248b2e39e9d0861f03204b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Military & AI[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Finished military initialization for major powers and medium European nations. [/p][/*][*][p]Military initialization is ongoing. While initial work on military initialization is making progress, implementation will require coordination across multiple systems. 	[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned AI behavior for Army Recruitment. It will be completed by the end of July. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI & Features[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Roughly half of the new UI for political parties and voting is done.[/p][/*][*][p]The new (our first official) loading screen is ready.  [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/c287b4d36339d33a415375cc154083276711ff34.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Art & Assets[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Adding the 3rd batch of historical leader heads to the game. [/p][/*][*][p]New historical portraits have been added into the game. However, implementation is still ongoing as outfits are being added and portraits still need to be attached to Leader profiles. [/p][/*][*][p]6 (out of 8) 3D buildings should be done. Artwork has been completed. However, as mentioned previously, implementation is currently on hold pending other development factors. 	[/p][/*][*][p]Cavalry 3D unit is complete. 	[/p][/*][*][p]Artwork for 7 new Leader backgrounds has been completed. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Targets for the End of July[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Finish editing the terrain for South and Central Africa[/p][/*][*][p]Update to the new Trade UI [/p][/*][*][p]New balancing draft for the economy, which will be tested and refined in the coming months. [/p][/*][*][p]Merge Pop religion, culture, and profession refinements [/p][/*][*][p]Begin work on refining Pop distributions for North America [/p][/*][*][p]Continue working on the official Glossary [/p][/*][*][p]Complete Music Player UI [/p][/*][*][p]Complete Flag Editor UI [/p][/*][*][p]Complete Political Parties UI [/p][/*][*][p]Continue creating Leader Portraits—Historical Leaders and Generic Portraits [/p][/*][*][p]Complete artwork for about 28 Leader outfits [/p][/*][*][p]Update AI behaviors for Army Recruitment and Mobilization[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Map Mode Filter system [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Looking Ahead to August[/h3][hr][/hr][p]We will share our plan for August at the beginning of the month, and as our goals evolve and milestones are reached, we will continue to keep you informed.

Join the Gilded Destiny Discord [url="https://discord.com/invite/3d77T9gxDF"]Server[/url] and our subreddit, [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/gildeddestiny/"]r/GildedDestiny[/url]

You can also follow us on the following socials: [url="https://x.com/GildedDestiny"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@aquilainteractive"]YouTube[/url], and[url="https://www.facebook.com/AquilaIA/"] Facebook[/url].

As always, thank you for your support and for reading!

May your day be a gilded one![/p]

[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/d45af12c746578679fed65227e1c3aa50de46d2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Salutations Industrialists,[/h3][p][/p][p]We're excited to share the progress we've made in May and early June and update you on our Alpha Roadmap.[/p][p][/p][p]We are happy to announce that we are getting close to the release of the Closed Alpha! As you may have heard in the latest Dev Diary on Map Modes, we have sent out Non-Disclosure agreements to our Kickstarter backers. In addition to having early access to the game, our backers will be an integral part of the development of Gilded Destiny. One of the main purposes of the closed Alpha will be to gather focused, high-quality feedback from devoted and passionate players while key systems are still in development. Again, we are thrilled to be bringing the closed Alpha to our supporters who backed us on Kickstarter![/p][p][/p][p]If you are one of our backers on Kickstarter, please head over to Kickstarter for more information in the previous update about accessing the NDA.[/p][p][/p][p]We’d like to thank you for your continued patience as we work toward the Alpha release. That said, we’ve been making steady progress on several key features of Gilded Destiny. Over the past weeks, much of our attention has been devoted to preparing for the closed Alpha, handling essential pre-release tasks, and polishing various game systems behind the scenes. First and foremost, we want to thank you for your continued patience as we develop and refine Gilded Destiny to a level that will be playable and enjoyable to our early testers.[/p][p][/p][p]Without further ado, let's take a look at what we accomplished in May and what is planned for June.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf"][b]Join the Gilded Destiny Discord Server[/b][/url]

[/p][h3]Accomplished in May[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Edit Terrain of South America and begin editing terrain of Africa[/b][/p][p]We have updated several areas:[/p][list][*][p]Qing Dynasty (Taiwan, Hainan, Amur, Fujian, Zhejiang, Shandong, Jiangsu, Northeast, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Africa (Morocco, Tiris, Tagant, Trarza, Algiers, Tunisia, Sokoto, Bornu, Tibesti, Haray, Darfur, Wadai, Bamana Kingdom, Western Sahara, Cameroon, Gabon, Congo, Portugal, Buonda, Lunda Kingdom, Skeleton Coast, Cape, Xhosa, Zulu Kingdom, Kalahari Desert, Upper Vaal, Gaza Empire, Tabora, Ruvuma, Oman Empire, Swahili Coast, Mozambique, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]America (US West Coast Mountains, Canadian East Islands, South American Terrain, Spain Terrain).[/p][/*][*][p]Egypt (East, Northwest, Southwest).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Cultural Heritages and Religious Convictions: [/b]Continue design and implementation of Cultural Heritages and Religious Convictions, aiming to cover the major Religious Convictions and finalize Religious Groups by the end of May.[/p][list][*][p] This has been delayed. notes.title: Alpha Roadmap Update #13
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/da498439a4a32d7d9e43099f0d4fb2a600a4d8fb.png[/img]

[h3]Salutations Industrialists,[/h3]
 
We're excited to share the progress we've made in April and update you on our Alpha Roadmap.

Work on the economy continues, but is nearly resolved. Meanwhile, work continues on many other features, as you'll see below. Our team also completed several tasks than we had not listed for May in the last roadmap, so please see those below too!

Also, we'd like to thank you for your patience on this roadmap. We’re steadily advancing on several key features of Gilded Destiny as we prepare for the Alpha release to our Kickstarter and Modian backers. Right now, a major focus for the dev team is fine-tuning the in-game economy and population systems. The core challenge lies in ensuring that Pop behavior—how they consume, produce, and trade—remains balanced and consistent within the broader economy. Once these systems are functioning as intended and have passed thorough testing, we’ll be ready to deliver the Alpha build to our backers.

Without further ado, let's take a look at what we accomplished in April and what is planned for May.

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf]Join the Gilded Destiny Discord Server[/url][/b]

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[h3]Accomplished in April[/h3]

[b]Continue testing the newly implemented Trade system[/b]
[list]
[*] Testing is ongoing. As Trade is integral to the proper function of the in-game economy and many other systems, such as Production, testing is planned to continue for the coming months as new features are added and existing mechanics are adjusted.
[/list]

[b]Continue Editing terrain of Southeastern and Central Asia [/b]
[list]
[*] Terrain of the Qing Empire has been completed.
[/list]

[b]Implement Qing events[/b]
[list]
[*] Initial early events have been implemented. We plan to add more content soon.
[/list]

[b]Continue designing Major US events.[/b] 
[list]
[*] The Major US events have been designed and partially implemented. Further implementation is pending group modifiers to be developed and input into the game.
[*] Major event chains include:
  - The Trail of Tears
  - The US Civil War
  - The Mexican-American War
  - Texan Revolution
[/list]

[b]Continue fixing bugs reported by QA testers and pre-Alpha testers[/b]
[list]
[*] Ongoing. QA testers continue to test the stable and pre-Alpha builds.
[/list]

[b]Adjust various economic features, such as tariffs, to align with the new Trade system[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress is being made. Tariffs are functioning in game and appear to have the desired effect. QA testers are currently verifying that they work correctly. Development and refining of the Trade System is ongoing.
[*] Added a feature to allow different sectors to have separate tariff rates (agricultural, military, industrial, etc)
[/list]

[b]Complete implementation of Rebellions---Test, and update[/b]
[list]
[*] Ongoing. The system is currently working as intended. Refinement will continue into May.
[/list]

[b]Update and refine policy modifiers and tech modifiers[/b]
[list]
[*] Pushed to May
[/list]

[b]Continue designing and implementing cultural heritages and religious convictions[/b]
[list]
[*] Work is being done on this currently, but more focused development will occur in May.
[/list]

[b]Begin implementation of Bureaucratic efficiency system[/b]
[list]
[*] Done!
[/list]

[b]Political Parties[/b]
[list]
[*] Design for Political Parties is complete, including details of how they will interact with existing game systems.
[/list]

[b]Continue implementing with clothing and portraits[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress is being made, and our team is implementing more Leaders into the game. Our art team is working with an outsourcing studio which draws most clothing and portraits. Once our in-house art team approves, our artists will touch up each portrait before being sent for implementation into the game.
[/list]

[b]Working on updating the Trade UI[/b]
[list]
[*] The main interface for the Trade is largely complete, and should be completed by the end of May.
[/list]

[b]Continue work on map modes[/b]
[list]
[*] Map Modes have been implemented and design has been largely completed. Our Artists still need to update a few remaining icons for a few map layers. Several new map views have been introduced, including War Exhaustion, Technology, Literacy Rate, Unemployment, Resource Points, and GDP views. The map modes system now supports dynamic parameters, paving the way for more complex views like Production by Good type. Transitions between map modes are now smoother, and color shading (especially in gray-scale regions) has been optimized with a dynamic grayscale system for better clarity. Finally, existing views like Culture, Religion, and Military Recruitment have been refined with better color logic and tooltip presentation, particularly at different map zoom levels.
[/list]

[h3]Extra tasks accomplished in April[/h3]

[b]Begin researching additional on Leaders / adding more into the game[/b]
[list]
[*] Compiled a list of influential figures for our major countries. These concern all of our leader types, so determining which scientists to add, which generals, which presidents/prime ministers, etc... Most of these will not have custom portraits, but they can appear as leaders during their lifetime with appropriate stats.
[/list]

[b]Begin designing additional Leader Traits[/b]
[list]
[*] This has been pushed to May. Generally, this will involve a review of our current leader traits and a brief design discussion to standardize what leader traits should offer.
[/list]

[b]Begin inputting initial data for military units, currently working on the UK[/b]
[list]
[*] Work has started on this area, and will continue into May and June as we input military data for other countries.
[/list]

[b]Added New AI Systems[/b]
[list]
[*] Added systems for restarting closed buildings, managing national reserves, and enabling investment behavior by smallholders and artisans.
[/list]

[b]Diplomacy AI Logic Redesign[/b]
[list]
[*] Peace negotiation behavior of AI has been made less rigid and formulaic in order to make outcomes feel more organic and responsive.
[/list]

[b]Smarter Construction AI[/b]
[list]
[*] Provincial building AI has been adjusted to prevent over-construction in newly developed regions.
[/list]

[b]Camera Controls Tuned[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved responsiveness and behavior for zooming and panning across different game systems.
[/list]

[b]UI Layer Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Made several enhancements to how UI elements display at various zoom levels, including: 1) differentiation between major and minor city labels to reduce visual clutter and 2) adding small icons for buildings and resource nodes for better at-a-glance clarity.
[/list]


[h3]End of May[/h3]

[b]World Map[/b]
- Edit Terrain of South America and begin editing terrain of Africa
- Cultural Heritages and Religious Convictions
- Continue design and implementation of Cultural Heritages and Religious Convictions, aiming to cover the major Religious Convictions and finalize Religious Groups by the end of May.

[b]Authority and Government Support[/b]
- Update and refine systems involving the generation and use of Authority, and review the impact of the Government Support system. 
- Review and update configuration of POP Political Power system

[b]Political Parties[/b]
- Begin implementation of new Political Parties design.

[b]Policies[/b]
- Update and refine the modifiers for Policies in line with new game systems.

[b]Economy[/b]
- Continue refining economic behavior and updating initial economic world-state based on historical data.

[b]Rebellions[/b]
- Complete implementation of Rebellion system.

[b]AI[/b]
- Finalize AI for province-level policy management
- Implement AI systems for leader recruitment and assignment to governmental, province, or military postings

[b]UI[/b]
- Complete design of Navy UI
- Complete redesign of Flag Editor UI
- Continue refining Map UI elements for clarity and performance

[b]POPs[/b]
- Refine distribution of POP cultures, religions, and professions in Western Europe and Russia, based on historical data.

[b]Diplomacy[/b]
- Begin planning for refining and expanding on Diplomacy system


We will share our plan for June at the beginning of the month. As our goals and expectations evolve, and as these milestones are reached, we will keep you updated!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Also, as a reminder—we have assigned Discord roles to our backers who are already part of our server. If you are not a member of our server, please join via the link below and say hello in the chat to ensure that you claim your role!

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf]Join the Gilded Destiny Discord Server[/url][/b]

[b]Pre-Alpha Testing Continues[/b]

As many of you are already aware, we have launched the Pre-Alpha of Gilded Destiny to a small group of about 100 testers chosen from our Kickstarter and Modian backers at random. So far, we have received lots of constructive feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. As we continue to develop certain systems for Gilded Destiny, we are also now beginning to transition to a more feedback-based approach to development. The pre-Alpha testers have helped a great deal to isolate bugs and to improve playability. We look forward to sharing the game with more of you very soon!

As we've mentioned previously, we decided to do a small closed Pre-Alpha test to gather initial feedback so that experience of the Alpha is enjoyable and meaningful, and to streamline the process of administrating keys, feedback collection, and bug reporting on our end. Of course, as many of you know, both the pre-Alpha and Alpha builds of the game will likely have limited content and systems may not be fully implemented into the game.
 
 
Thanks for your support and for reading!
May your day be a gilded one!

[h3]Salutations Industrialists,[/h3]

[b]Begin designing early US Events[/b]
  - Some initial design work has been completed. Work will continue into April. 

[b]Continue adjusting and refining the global economy[/b]  
   - This is an ongoing process. Improvements have been made to the economic system. With the implementation of a redesigned trade system in games, we hope to resolve several of the major bugs plaguing the economy right now. 

[b]Update initial country stats for Europe and the Americas[/b]
  - Done.

[b]Refine and update the placement of resources and the availability of plantation goods in various provinces[/b]
  - Refinement has begun and will continue into April.

[b]Refine and update design for the effects of Leader Positions[/b]
  - Done. These have been refined and are ready for implementation.

  - Done.

[b]Update and refine Culture, Religion, and Profession distribution in Europe[/b]
  - Pushed back.

  - Underway, a few have been implemented and will be assigned to pops.

[b]Add new Leader Traits[/b]
  - Delayed. Pushed back.

[b]Complete the Settings and Save/Load Menu Art Design[/b]
  - Art designs have been completed. Awaiting implementation

  - Several new country-specific uniforms have been added to the game. These now need to be synced with leader portraits. And one general European military uniform has been added, which can currently be seen in the game.

[b]Continued performance optimization, through internal QA testing and bug reports and feedback from Pre-Alpha testers[/b]
  - The internal QA team has been growing and is creating procedures to optimize workflow. Performance continues to be optimized in the game build.

[b]Redesign and Implement new Trade system[/b]
  - With the hope of addressing issues with the Economy, our devs have designed and implemented a new trade system. If the new Trade system is successful, after thorough testing, we are much closer to releasing the Alpha build.



[b]Extras Added in March:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added New AI behaviors, including Building Construction and the adjustment of Tariffs and Government Expenses[/b]
[*] [b]Implemented the HUD UI Design
[*] Implementation of Rebellion system is underway
[*] Navy System design is currently being finalized
[*] Updates to schools and literacy rates are in progress
[*] Bureaucratic efficiency design is currently being finalized
[*] Further refinements to population job transfers and transfer rates[/b]
[/list]

[previewyoutube=IlSty_CmGws;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]

[*] Southeastern and Central Asia 
[*] Finish designing early Italian Events
[*] Implement Qing events
[*] Continue  designing Early US events. 
[*] Continue fixing bugs reported by QA testers and pre-Alpha testers

[*] Continue designing and implementing cultural heritages and religious convictions
[*] Begin implementation of Bureaucratic efficiency system
[*] Continue implementing with clothing and portraits
[*] Working on updating the Trade UI
[*] Continue work on map view modes
[/list]

[h3]Major Accomplishments in the Last Year![/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworking the entire UI and making it more consistent
[*] Creating an improved and more readable visual language to improve UI/UX
[*] The release of the pre-alpha
[*] Reworking the Event Editor, including making changes to improve usability for modders
[*] Developing Prussian events to develop design standards for game content
[*] Creating a demo build and sharing the game at Gamescom

[h2]Script for Dev Diary 26:[/h2]


Salutations industrialists! I'm Marc, a Producer working on Gilded Destiny. 

In today's dev diary we're going to talk a bit about the HUD, or heads up display, in the game. It's the bar at the top of the screen that will give you relevant and up to date information about the game. We will discuss the general design approach and what main each element represents. As one of the most visible parts of the UI, it is important that the HUD both looks good and is easy to interact with.

Without further ado, let's dive in.

In designing the HUD, we wanted it to function more like a dashboard rather than a simple resource bar. Its primary purpose is to give you context about what is happening in your country, informing you on decisions that you, as a player, can make or will need to make. Each section of the HUD displays information about a specific, core aspect of gameplay, corresponding to the tabs in the left hand menu. Each section will update in real time in order to offer some continuity about what has been happening in the game. The main elements of the HUD are indicator icons to provide information at a glance, important stats relating to each section, notifications to highlight important information or events, and buttons to adjust speed of the game, get extra help through our planned wiki, and of course select your favorite music from Gilded Destiny's soundtrack.

One thing to point out as well, is that we are proud to say the new HUD has just been implemented into the game. So, bear with us on any tool tip text and features of the hud that are still very much work in progress.

In the budget section of the HUD, we get information that is relevant for making financial decisions about our country. Front and center, you see the amount of money in your Treasury, with the weekly change in parentheses. The idea is to provide context on how your finances are changing over time and show a historical trend on your budget surpluses and deficits—providing a bit of continuity in gameplay so you have a clear idea of the trajectory of where things are going.

Moving on to politics, you can see actionable information directly relating to your government. At the top, you can see the icons for Authority and Government Support. Both of these are essential for you to monitor as the game progresses, as any unexpected changes in these could be a harbinger of hard times ahead for your rule. The indicator icons here will notify you when there is an action to be taken. The one that looks like a document will indicate whether you currently have a Decision that can be enacted. And the icon showing a silhouette, in the same shape as our policy icons, will light up if you are currently able to change any Policies.

In the diplomacy section, you will see information that relates how the rest of the world sees your country. That is, at the top, you'll see Influence and Infamy which of course will change depending on which decisions you make and those that other countries make in the game (for more information, you can check out our Dev Diary on diplomacy). You can see your current diplomatic status in the center. And below, you can see the three indicator icons. The globe indicates whether you can currently perform any diplomatic actions. The puzzle piece indicates whether you currently have a country that can be released, which can be done in the 'Release Nation' tab in the Politics Panel. The document and sword icon indicates whether you have a casus belli available. 

For technology, we're presented with the current state of research across the three branches (Academia, Industry, and Military) and the average literacy rate and technology diffusion on the top, which both have a role in how technological progress is advancing in your country. Literacy rate will affect the research output of your POPs, as well as promotion and demotion of various POP groups. If you're interested in hearing more, be sure to check out our Dev Diary about technology.

When it comes to trade, you will see your current trade balance, along with the top goods that you're buying and selling in terms of value, not quantity. Because otherwise, if we do quantity, it will just be basic foods effectively. Trade balance is also calculated in terms of value, and can be useful for determining whether you should adjust your production, trade policies, or perhaps tariffs... If you want to influence the balance of goods being exported versus imported. 

With a quick glance at the Population section of the HUD, you'll get important information on the current state of your POPs. First, you can see the values for Average Happiness and Average Unrest, which is still awaiting implementation and coming soon, as you can see. Moving on to the indicator icons. The Torch and Pitchfork indicates that you have provinces that have high enough Unrest to start receiving Unrest events. The bowl and spoon indicates that there are unwashed dishes in your sink... or rather that there are Pops who are currently not receiving their Essential Needs.

In Production, you'll see up-to-date information about your workforce and status regarding production. On the top, you'll see your current unemployment rate and average province connectivity. Unemployment rate obviously ties directly into your production capacity, whereas average province connectivity indicates how efficiently your goods can travel across your nation. If a factory is losing money, the factory indicator icon will light up. And, if you are subsidizing one or more buildings, the coin will light up.

Military shows you the current numbers for war exhaustion and the percentage of Soldiers and Officers currently employed in the military. Below that, you can see the number of regiments and and the number of fleets currently serving in your country's army and navy.

This popout shows a list of global wars. You can open or close this popout by clicking on the "eye" button. The crossed swords button opens the list of ongoing wars (which will open a more detailed view). As you can see, the edges of the popout have a burnt outline, and when your country is at war, you'll see glowing embers there too.

Here, you'll be able to choose the game speed. From Pause all the way up to light speed - well, speed five, that is. Of course there are keyboard shortcuts for that too.

Here you can open our music player, which we are planning to redesign. In case you're wondering about why we chose a Treble Clef, we simply thought it meshed well with the overall UI, and is perhaps the most recognizable to the general population as well. Also, there's the fact that a certain producer of Gilded Destiny is most comfortable with reading Treble Clef. But, here's a shoutout to all bass clef and tenor clef musicians. 

Here you will be able to open the planned Gilded Destiny wiki.

And here, you will be able to return to the main menu. Where you can save the game, close the game, or exit to desktop, or close the dev diary...


So, that's probably a good place to close this dev diary. But, a few final updates.

We're making good progress refining several of the important features of Gilded Destiny, in preparation for the release of the Alpha version of the game to our Kickstarter and Modian backers. Importantly, our dev teams are devoting much of their focus on resolving a few issues with the in-game economy and population. The main problems we are facing are maintaining the integrity of how the pops consume, produce, and trade in-game, which ties into the economy. Once these systems working properly, and once we've thoroughly tested them, we are planning to release the Alpha. For more information on our development schedule, check out our eleventh Alpha Roadmap, linked in the description.

Finally, all of us at Aquila Interactive want to thank our community of backers for their continued patience. We endeavor to release the Alpha as soon as possible, but more importantly than that we want to bring you a game that is enjoyable and playable, where the core systems are largely functioning, even if content and other features are still being developed.

We hope you've enjoyed this Dev Diary, and as always, if you have any questions or comments, let us know below.

Lastly, remember to subscribe to our YouTube channel and, if you have not done so already, add Gilded Destiny to your Steam wishlist. 

Until our paths converge once more, we bid thee farewell!

May your destiny be a gilded one.

[h2]Script for Dev Diary 24:[/h2]

Greetings, fellow industrialists. This year is set to be full of updates and I'm happy to present our first Dev Diary of 2025. My name is James and I'm a content designer for Gilded Destiny. Today we'll be talking about the specifics for how players can influence their country at the province level. Before we dive into that, though...

As many of you are already aware, we have launched the pre-Alpha of Gilded destiny for a small group of about 100 testers chosen from our Kickstarter and Modian backers. We have received lots of constructive feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. Based on this feedback, we are revisiting a few design features, revising some mechanics, and reworking several UIs. Once we have implemented some of these changes, and worked out a few bits about the Economy, we plan to bring the pre-Alpha to more testers when it's ready. As mentioned in our last Dev Diary, we do intend to offer a way to purchase the Alpha for Gilded Destiny for those who joined our community after the Kickstarter concluded. Also, be sure to check out the January Alpha Roadmap for all the latest.

Now, on to provinces. To start with, the province UI has received a slight rework. Let's look at Pomerania. Going point by point, we first have the province name at the top. Because we want players to have full control over their countries, you'll notice we allow all provinces to be renamed. If I click on the pen icon to the right, I can change Pomerania to whatever name I like. 

Continuing down the province view, we'll stay on the overview tab where we can see the option to appoint a governor. For detailed information about leaders, please see our video coving them linked in the description.

While we are still adding features to what governors can accomplish, one of the role's primary uses is for our leaders to gain experience for higher positions in the government down the line.
Next, we can see some basic information about Pomerania. It has a population of 646,000 and provides 120M to our total GDP. Tax efficiency and stability are still being worked on, so I won't cover those. And do keep in mind all numbers are subject to change.

Towards the bottom of the window, there is a list of major cities. In 1822, both Stolp and Koslin only had about 5000 people each. Of course, they will both grow considerably through the 19th century. Stolp shows that it contains 1 factory. 

Clicking on it opens the building tab of the city view. The factory is a textile mill converting cotton into textiles. 

Viewers might have noticed pretty important city that was not included. Stettin, of course, was a major Pomeranian city. However, we have separated that into the province of Cispomerania, though historically they were a part of the same Prussian province.

Before covering edicts, I will quickly take us through the other 3 tabs in the province view. The buildings tab has a list of all non-city buildings in the province. Currently, Pomerania has a single sea port for province buildings. We can see that there is the potential for 71 agricultural buildings and 1 natural resource building.

The Population tab gives an overview of Pomerania's demographics. Mousing over a few of the pie charts, the Pops here are about 85% smallholders, 90% North German, and 90% Protestant. Overall, there are roughly 659,000 Pops, and because this is the first day of the game there is no immediate migration yet. However, we do display domestic migration, international migration, and Pop promotion/demotion. Scrolling down, there is some basic economic information relating to Pops such as their current average savings, income vs. Expenses, and unemployment rate. It would seem that our Pops here aren't in great shape with expenses nearly double their income. Prussia might be in for a bit of trouble if that is not remedied.

Let's take a closer look at our economy in the next tab to see why. First off, Pomerania has 100% market connectivity, so no issue there. There is a single factory which is our textile mill in Stolp from earlier. It would be good to have more factories, but those will take time and investment. If we look at our top products and demands in the province, the issue become apparent. Despite grain, logs, and fish being our top products, we can't meet our demand in any of them. Prussia was going through a difficult transition following the Napoleonic Wars and much of the peasantry struggled to support themselves. Similar issues were happening all across Europe as the great powers tried to re-establish the old order in a rapidly changing world. The gap between income and expenses that we saw in the Population tab is a problem that the player can solve to better the conditions in their country. However, it won't be an easy fix. Let's look at some of the tools we have available: industry support and province edicts.
The primary use for industry support is to influence investment behavior and Pop promotion. While your capitalists will look for investments that show the best returns, the player has foresight that Pops lack. Anticipating how a new technology will influence the flow of the global trade can put your country at a comparative advantage if you direct your investors ahead of the curve. However, keep in mind that encouraging a specific industry does not mean that industry is profitable. Similarly, encouraging a specific workforce does not provide jobs for the newly promoted. Industry support should be used in tandem with the demands of your country. Societal change does not happen overnight. Push your country too far too quickly, and the change you see might not be for the better.

Scrolling through the window, there is a support option for each pop type as well as for each good type. The authority cost for each support option is shown and it's important to keep in mind that these are paid on activation as well as each following month.

Province Edicts by contrast represent more tailored effects. We currently have 9 edicts but there are more planned in the future as various game systems are completed. Edicts tend to have a combination of benefits and detriments. For example, clear-cut forestry will increase the output of you logging camps, but the increased erosion will harm both farm and plantation output. Similarly, mandated mining quotas will increase mine output, but it will also increase the mortality rate for workers in the province while decreasing the rate that new Pops promote to the worker job type as the job becomes less appealing overall. I'd like to draw your attention to one edict in particular that might not seem very useful at first. The Austerity measures edict has two primary effects. The first is that it decreases the amount of luxury goods that your upper and middle class Pops desire. The second effect is that it lowers the happiness of your upper and middle class pops as well. That first effect might look odd, because decreasing overall consumption in your country could have a deflating effect on your economy. However, because your higher strata Pops are spending less on luxury goods, they will have more money available to invest This kind of edict rewards the player who can identify when they should encourage long term investment over the benefits of immediate consumption.

Now that we understand the tools we have at our disposal, let's return to the problem facing our Pops in Pomerania. We saw that our textile mill was not fully employing clerks and that we were not meeting our need for grain, timber, and fish. To fix our clerk problem, let's encourage promotion to the clerk job type. That will get some of our Pops into better paying jobs so that they can afford the goods they need on the national and international markets. Next, let's increase our timber production to open up more jobs producing a highly demanded good. To do this, I'll enter the building menu and start construction on a logging camp. I will then return to the province view and encourage timber using the industry support. Also, let's set the edict clear-cut forestry. Because our province currently lacks farms and plantations, there is no downside to increasing our timber output. While this will not solve our goods problem immediately, I hope the steps I have taken here demonstrate the kinds of challenges you'll face in Gilded Destiny as well as the steps you can take to solving them.

Before wrapping up then, I'd like to talk a bit about the modding potential province edicts have. Currently, we have them setup to allow for any effect or modifier we have in the game. For example, if you wanted to make an edict like "mandated fasting" you could remove the food requirement from all Pops in the province as well as increase the mortality rate by 1000%. Or you could make an edict that immediately spawns an army ready for battle, but that gives every neighboring country a casus belli to take that province. It's really up to your imagination and we will continue to add more effects as development progresses.

Alright, that's it for today's Dev Diary. Remember to subscribe to our YouTube channel and, if you have not done so already, add Gilded Destiny to your Steam wishlist. Until our paths converge once more, we bid thee farewell!

Thank you for watching.

May your destiny be a gilded one.

Be sure to listen closely to the backing tracks in all our videos—they are the pieces you will come to hear in the game, composed by John Skoog. Also, the solo clarinet on this track was performed by yours truly, Marc.

notes.title: Alpha Roadmap Update #9
notes.content:
[h3]Salutations Industrialists,[/h3]
 
I'm excited to share the progress we've made over the last month and update you on our Alpha Roadmap. While internal testing and the Pre-Alpha phase still continues, we are making good progress to the Alpha and look forward to sharing it with you soon, when it is ready.

[b]Pre-Alpha Testing Continues[/b]

As many of you are already aware, we have launched the Pre-Alpha of Gilded Destiny to a small group of about 100 testers chosen from our Kickstarter and Modian backers at random. So far, we have received lots of constructive feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. As we continue to develop certain systems for Gilded Destiny, we are also now beginning to transition to a more feedback-based approach to development. The pre-Alpha testers have helped a great deal to isolate bugs and to improve playability. We look forward to sharing the game with more of you very soon!

As we've mentioned previously, we decided to do a small closed Pre-Alpha test to gather initial feedback so that experience of the Alpha is enjoyable and meaningful, and to streamline the process of administrating keys, feedback collection, and bug reporting on our end. Of course, as many of you know, both the pre-Alpha and Alpha builds of the game will likely have limited content and systems may not be fully implemented into the game.
 
[b]Physical Merch Shipping Update[/b]

Finally, we have shipped all physical merch to our Kickstarter and Modian backers. There are still a few who have not yet completed the backer survey. If you are reading this and have not done so yet, be sure to fill out the backer survey!
 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Without further ado, let's take a look at what we accomplished in December and what is planned for January and February.

[h3]End of December[/h3]
[i]Since some of the team was absent over the holiday period, we had slightly slower progress for December. However, there are still several important updates we would like to share.[/i]

[b]Continue inputting Prussian events, and testing new Event Editor systems[/b]
  - Progress is being made. Inputting events will continue. A new version of the Event Editor has been released to our Content Designers, which will make it easier and more efficient to input events in the future.

[b]Input more Leader portraits and backgrounds[/b]
  - Delayed. This has been pushed to January.

[b]Continue refining Global Economy systems[/b]
  - Ongoing. Further progress will be made in January.

[b]Continue inputting and refining historical population data for European countries at game start[/b]
  - Ongoing.

[b]Finish implementing Construction UI[/b]
  - Much of the Construction UI has been implemented, pending a few additional adjustments. The UI has been updated to display more info to the player such as province GDP percentage and map mode. This allows the player to better understand the state of their economy at a glance.

[b]New supplementary UI designs for other features (country selection, loading screen, main menu, etc.)[/b]
  - This will be an ongoing task. In December, the new UI for Country Selection has been redesigned to display more country information. And the new design for the End Game screen is in progress.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221501/59e04f167d71f90e16cdbf446a8a42014ceb9015.png[/img]

[b]New design for the game HUD[/b]
  - In progress. The new UI design will be finished early January.

[b]Finalize design for Rebellions[/b]
  - The new design has been created

[b]Add new flags into the game[/b]
  - Several new flags have been designed. Our Content Designers are continuing their research to add more. As a side note, the process of finding historical flags can be difficult, especially for some of the smaller countries during the 19th century. Where historical flags cannot be found, our Content Designers search for other historical symbols or emblems of the country that could serve as a flag. Notably, it has been difficult to find flags for 19th-century separatist factions in Afghanistan and the smaller countries of Oceana.

[b]Begin implementation of the new Bug Report UI into the game[/b]
  - Done. The new Bug Report UI has been input and tested. Bug Reports submitted via the in game Bug Reporting interface will automatically be added to our devs' internal task tracking program.

[b]Continue refining terrain (such as mountains, lakes, and rivers)[/b]
  - The First Draft of North America is nearly complete. Next we will move onto East Asia. 
Map View Function has been designed, and programmers are developing now. 
  - Still in development

[b]Adjust Diplomacy and expand new functions[/b]
  - All major new mechanics and functions have developed and implemented. Low priority effects and mechanics are waiting for implementation.

[b]Start adjustment of AI performance[/b]
  - Designs have been reviewed to increase AI depth, but implementation will be ongoing as continuous adjustments will be needed.

[h3]End of January[/h3]
- Begin implementing new UI designs for the HUD and Settings menus
- Begin designing major Chinese Events
- Complete inputting Prussian events and testing new Event Editor systems
- Complete input of new Bug Report feature and update UI
- Continue updating and refining Global Economy systems
- Complete refining and updating design for POP promotion and migration
- Continue refining terrain (such as mountains, lakes, and rivers)
  - Central Asia, Middle East, and South Asia
- Finalize design for Bureaucracy
- New supplementary UI designs for other features (loading screen, main menu, end game, etc.)
- New design for the game HUD
- Design more Cultural Heritages and Religious Convictions
- Refine and update technology tree, and design UI for in-game technology tree visualization
  - Since our technology system includes some element of randomness (see our Dev Diary), we are planning to include a visualization of the technology tree so that players can have a clearer sense of technological progression. 
  - We also intend for the visualization of the technology tree to be moddable in the editor.

[h3]End of February[/h3]
- Begin implementation of Rebellion mechanics
- Begin inputting major Chinese events
- Begin designing and inputting minor events for European countries
- More plans to come for February at the end of the month. We are assessing the current needs of the game. 

As our goals and expectations evolve, and as these milestones are reached, we will keep you updated!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Also, as a reminder—we have assigned Discord roles to our backers who are already part of our server. If you are not a member of our server, please join via the link below to ensure that you claim your role!
Join the Gilded Destiny Discord Server

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf]Join the Gilded Destiny Discord Server[/url][/b]

Thanks for your support and for reading!

May your day be a gilded one!

[h2]Script for Dev Diary 23:[/h2]

Seasons Greetings, industrialists!

I'm Marc, a Producer for Gilded Destiny. And, still getting over that cold.

Another year has come and gone. As we wrap up 2024, I hope this year has been as productive, merry, and gilded for you, as it has been for us at Aquila Interactive. In this Dev Diary, I'd like to reflect on what has been accomplished this year on Gilded Destiny and at Aquila.

I want to express my gratitude, on behalf of everyone at Aquila, to all of you for being part of our growing community over the last year—from followers on social media, active members of our Discord, content creators we have worked with, our backers on Kickstarter and Modian, and the few pre-Alpha testers who have provided us valuable feedback. We are humbled, encouraged, and excited by all of the feedback we continue to receive about the game development. As always, please continue sharing suggestions, asking questions, and improving our vision of the game.

The year is coming to an end, and as we are all settling in for the holiday, I think it is an essential time for us to highlight some of the progress we have made this year and what we have our sights set on going forward!

So, without any further ado, let's take a little look back in time.

At the very beginning of 2024, we were looking forward to share our first video of gameplay, but had not done so yet. We gave a first sneak peak of gameplay, in January, however, with the release of the Kickstarter announcement trailer! Our Kickstarter ran during March and April, and brought in £31,974, which was 159% of our funding goal! The main reason we launched a Kickstarter was to promote the game and introduce it to a wider audience of potential players. On all counts, the Kickstarter and Modian were a success. In September and October we shipped physical merch to all of the backers who supported us at the higher tiers. And in November, we shared the first pre-Alpha build of the game with a small group of randomly selected backers. So far, we have received lots of constructive feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. Early next year, we will be bringing the Alpha build of the game to our Kickstarter and Modian backers. We also intend to offer others, who did not back our Kickstarter or Modian, a way join the Alpha once it is fully released.

In 2024, Gilded Destiny has undergone several major revisions and redesigns: to name a few—Reimagining the game UI, Artwork, and portraits; Creating, updating, or redesigning several game systems and mechanics; implementing major updates the editor; and doing a major rework of the map to improve performance and visuals.

For 2025, our goal is simple—we plan to make sure we have playable loop and polish it to the point to where it would be fun. All of the major features we want are in the game already. However, now is the time where we need to focus on balancing and refinement, and redesign as needed. A main focus will be refining the economy system so that it does not destabilize a few months into the game, and addressing several known issues, such as unexplained population explosions. We also plan to overhaul the Military UI, which works currently, but it does not meet our expectations for being user-friendly.

In 2024, the UI and game artwork has been vastly redesigned. Since coming on board, Timor, our Art Director, has created a consistent visual language throughout the UI and game artwork. He and his team of artists continue to refine many of the UI and UX components that will make gameplay fun, intuitive, and immersive. Examples, include Trade, Technology, Country and Province UIs, and many more. You can check out our Dev Diary on UI Considerations for more. In addition, you have had a preview of some of the new artwork and portrait styles for Leaders in our game. We will be implementing more of these in 2025.

The Technology system has been thought out, designed, and implemented into the game. You will be able to appoint Leaders to research techs in one of three disciplines: Military, Academia, or Industry. Your interactions with other countries (through Research Diffusion), your country policies, Leader traits, research progression vis-a-vis the tech trees for each discipline, and a bit of randomness will determine your progress through the Tech trees. See the Dev Diary on Technology for more.

The Trade and Production system is an example of a system that has been redesigned significantly, and will end up being updated some more, in order to interact better with other systems we are redesigning, namely the Economy. Many of the features will stay the same, but we will likely be announcing some changes in the future. Nonetheless, you can see that creating systems is an iterative process. As one system or mechanic is changed, other systems require updating or redesign to work properly or take advantage of the previously changed system.

The general trend for the editor has been to increase its reach into the game code. Our goal is to allow our designers to run checks and effects on as many aspects of a country, province, or leader as possible so that our content can be responsive to the current state of a playthrough. We know that modders will want to have access to every aspect of the game, so, for example, even if we do not need to manually increase or decrease the population of a province, effects like that will be available. Furthermore, toward the end of the year, we have improved the UI for the editor, so that implementing content is easier and more efficient.

And, this brings us to the major overhaul of Gilded Destiny's map, which our Technical Artists and Programmers completed in the latter half of 2024. The Map Rework was aimed at improving performance, improving pathfinding for logistics and military units and supply, and making the map more beautiful—including improvements to coastlines, rivers, mountains, hills, and snowcapped mountains. While the backend of the Map Rework has finished, we are still going through working on the terrain and art assets and features on the map. You may have noticed a few incremental changes in the last few Dev Diaries, if you look closely.

Finally, in the last year, we have added many new members to our development team around the world. Our team actively working on Gilded Destiny has grown now to a few dozen. I'd like to take a minute to highlight a few of their contributions during their time with us!

Timor, our Art Director, said he is proud to have contributed to a new visual art style that will hopefully make the game more intuitive and easier to play. And that over the course of 2024, the UI has certainly changed for the better, in his humble opinion. For 2025, he most looks forward to the new art of the world map and the character portraits. 
Elena, one of our artists, has worked on several UIs, including the Colonization, Province, Country, and City UIs. She has also done a great job on creating the goods icons for the game. 
Stephanie, one of our artists, has done excellent work on significantly updating the UI Art in Technology.
Vincent, one of our technical designers and programmers, is proud to have worked to implement the redesigned Country UI and set up and implement some back end analytics in the game.
James, one of our content designers, has created several of our events in game so far, and also has designed an improved system to better aid country UI to understand their strategic system and set logical goals (more on AI in a future dev diary). 
Joe is one of our designers and has been an integral part of the redesign, development, and input the new diplomacy system. In 2025, he's looking forward to improving performance, adding more content, and balancing the game.
Our content designer, Basten, has contributed significantly to the map—adding and adjusting national and provincial borders and coastlines, adding cities, and currently refining terrain. He has also contributed to the military system design and has designed content for the military tech tree.

Andong, Gilded Destiny's Lead Designer, has a hand in almost everything. However, he wanted me to highlight the leader system, which is highly adaptable and flexible, and able to support many nuances in the game regarding culture and religion shifts, government types, various appointment methods (hereditary, electoral, or appointment), and adjusting term lengths.

James H done great work on publishing and business development, overseeing the successful Modian campaign in China, and expanding awareness of Gilded Destiny. And all of our backers who received their rewards have Sarah and James H to thank for coordinating shipping.

Nii implemented many of the changes to significantly improve the editor. And Luka has been building out the embedded map-editing functionality of the Editor.

Machilus has worked on the design for the right-click context menu and developing the game AI.

Also, I'd like to highlight Liximi's contribution to the redesign of the Country and Province UI, Mingqing's contribution to Policies and Technology, Charlotte's improvements to the construction system, and Tianyu's contribution to the music player, population logic, design of conditions and effects, and overall optimization.

And, of course, we have several more colleagues, who were not mentioned above, who have done great and integral work in developing Gilded Destiny this year and for whom we are incredibly grateful.

That's probably a good note to wrap up this Dev Diary—with wrapping paper and a bow, of course. We hope you've enjoyed it, and as always, if you have any questions or comments, let it snow.

As the season of joy and giving is upon us, don't forget to subscribe to our YouTube channel, so you can stay warm and cozy watching Gilded Destiny Dev Diaries over the holidays. And, if you haven’t already, add Gilded Destiny to your Steam Christmas wishlist, and be sure to check it twice.

Until our paths converge once more, we bid thee farewell with tidings of comfort and joy.

May your destiny shine as brightly as the gilded star on top of your tree.

notes.title: Gilded Destiny Pre-Alpha is Live
notes.content:
[h2]The Pre-Alpha has arrived![/h2]

[b]Salutations Industrialists![/b]

First, we would like to thank you for your support in the development of Gilded Destiny. 

We are excited to share Gilded Destiny with the small group of testers randomly selected from our Kickstarter and Modian!

As you are aware, Gilded Destiny is in the "Pre-Alpha" stage, which means that many systems are not yet complete or fully implemented. So, we ask you to bear with us as we continue implementation and refinement of systems and features. 

Below is an excerpt from the Alpha Testing Guidelines that we have sent out to the testers along with their Steam Keys.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

The purpose of these guidelines is to explain what feedback from you would be most useful for our dev team. Of course, we appreciate all feedback and suggestions you may have for Gilded Destiny, but as you might expect, we are particularly looking for feedback about specific features and bug reports that can help move Gilded Destiny to the next stage of development.

If you are not yet in our Discord server, we kindly ask that you join. The closed "Pre-Alpha Chat" channel will be the focal point for feedback and suggestions, and offer a place for you to get in touch with our devs (in addition to using the in-game Bug Report option, of course). Please use this link to join: https://discord.com/invite/m22Ek8jxJf


[b]What we expect from pre-Alpha and Alpha Testers:[/b]
1. That you will take the time to play Gilded Destiny and try to understand its systems and features
2. That you will provide constructive feedback and suggestions, being as specific as possible
3. That you will report any bugs or problems encountered while playing the game

[h2]Pre-Alpha Testing Guidelines[/h2]
Input from the Testing community is vital to shaping the game, and we appreciate your time, insights, and feedback as we continue building and refining it. Please carefully read the following guidelines before you begin.

1. Confidentiality Agreement
- All testers are bound by the confidentiality agreement they signed. This means that they cannot share screenshots, videos, game details, or any information about the game with anyone outside the pre-Alpha testing group. Publicly sharing any details of this Alpha test could jeopardize the project and the trust we’ve placed in our testing community.

2. Understanding the Alpha Stage
- This game is currently in its Alpha phase, meaning that several systems and features are still in development or only partially implemented. You may encounter bugs, placeholder assets, incomplete features, and performance issues. Here’s what you can expect:
  - Core systems are being actively developed. Some areas may lack full functionality.
  - Visuals and animations may include placeholders and temporary effects.
  - Performance optimizations are ongoing; you may experience lower frame rates or other performance issues.

3. What NOT to Focus On
- Visual fidelity or polish: Our art and visuals are not final, and many assets and placeholders remain in the game at this point. We will also be adding in many more portraits, background artwork, and icons.
- Performance optimizations: We’re aware that the game may lag or stutter, so please only report performance issues if they are severe and prevent gameplay.
- Minor UI and text issues: These will be polished in later stages.

4. Key Focus Areas
- Please pay extra attention to the following systems, as they are crucial to our current development focus:
  - Core gameplay mechanics  and features 
    - (e.g., warfare, diplomacy, production, research, trade, events etc.)
  - User interface usability
    - Most UIs have now been redesigned. However, a few old UI panels still remain in the game. You will likely be able to distinguish between the new and old UIs, so we ask that you please focus on newer UIs that have been implemented. And please focus your comments on the usability—ease of use, intuitiveness, whether all relevant information is provided, and readability.
  - The Globe—terrain and borders
    - Do you notice any regions, terrain, or borders that should be refined? We are still actively working on this, but appreciate feedback.
  - Progression and difficulty balance
    - Do the features and systems in the game seem balanced? Does the data for population and other resources in the game seem correct?
  - Enjoyment and Entertainment Value
    - We ultimately want to gauge whether or not the core gameplay loop is fun to play. In addressing this, we ask you to see beyond the current rough state of the game in its Alpha build, and look to what it is becoming. Of course, the normal gameplay loop at release, or even Early Access will not involve bug and error reporting.

5. Communication and Updates
- We will be releasing regular updates, so check for new versions and patch notes. Some issues you’ve found may be resolved in newer builds.
- Please feel free to ask questions if anything is unclear or if you’d like guidance on what to test next.
Thank you for being part of our journey! Your feedback is essential, and we’re excited to hear your thoughts on the game as it evolves.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
First, there are several known issues that we want to mention first. We know these issues exist and are planning to address them in future updates.
- List from Pre-Alpha Notes to Players
In Development
- Economy system still needs refinement and is not working fully yet
- Colonization system
- Naval system
- Rebellion
- Map Layers have not been developed yet
- The Game Wiki has not yet been created
- In-game Tutorial
- Steam Achievement system not developed
- Policies relating to Welfare and Slavery are still being developed
- Modding support and workshops are still in development
Needing Optimization
- Performance optimization is ongoing, and the current operating speed is not ideal
- The Events system needs to be improved to include more modifiers, triggering conditions, and effects. In addition, the ability to reference variables from other countries needs to be added
- There are significant optimization and adjustment plans for the population system
- AI behavior details need further testing and adjustment
- The actual effect of population transition immigration needs further testing and adjustment
- Migration system mechanics need further testing and refinement
- Mechanics for Job changes need further testing and refinement
- Modifiers for Units need to be refined to allow effects from Leaders, Technologies, and Polices
- Diplomacy still has some effects and conditions to be developed
- Occasionally there are multi-threaded errors during operation, which occasionally cause the game to crash
- The country selection interface needs to be re-optimized and adjusted
  - Including UI
- The game end interface needs to be redesigned and adjusted
- Trade mechanics are not stable enough and need to be optimized
Economy Design and Balance
- Systems such as Military, Diplomacy, Technology, Construction, Policy, and Leadership still need to be balanced and adjusted
- There is a significant difference between forecasted revenue and actual revenue in the fiscal UI
Content (Copywriting/Map)
- Initial content (initial technology, policies, military, etc.) is still being updated
- Currently only a few event chains for Prussia are in game. Many more for other countries need to be added
- Many more decisions also need to be added to the game
- A large amount of Tooltip information needs to be added and optimized to provide more complete and accurate information
- The content and sequence of technology still need to be tested and adjusted
- Most texts for Cultural Heritage are placeholders; a few have been implemented, but do not have all of their intended modifiers
- Most texts for Religious Conviction are placeholders; a few have been implemented, but do not have any of their intended modifiers
- There may be undiscovered text errors and localization errors, as well as inconsistency in names and terms used
- Country and province borders and terrain features on the game map still need to be refined

[h2]Game Artwork and UI/UX[/h2]
- The graphics quality of the map is being improved and updated, and there is still flickering
- Some flags are still placeholders
- Only a few Leader portraits have been implemented. We plan to add many more
- Some of the Soldier unit models are placeholders
- Many modules of the UI are still using old resources, waiting to be replaced
- Some of the icons in the Diplomacy UI are still placeholders
- Some of the icons in the Country UI are still placeholders
- Some of the icons in the Military UI are still placeholders
- A large number of icons in the Technology UI are still placeholders
- A large number of icons in Religion and Culture UIs are still placeholders
- Military UI is being redesigned, and then implemented
- Province UI has been redesigned, but still needs to be implemented
- "Build" (Construction) System is being redesigned, and then needs to be implemented

Thank you for your support!
